title: Hazy Maze Cave
coordinateSystem: Y up; source coordinates /100; yaw degrees from +Z toward +X

routeActions.instruction: Run, then crouch + jump across the gap
Hop the raised step in the boulder path
Stand on the elevator until it reaches the bottom
Swim to the tail, jump aboard, face the island, and ground pound the back. Hop onto the lowered head, ride it up, and jump to the island.
